description: Required actual input documents, not an execution result or placeholder receipt.

config_fields.gates: binding to actual completed execution.json with all eight receipts and logs
config_fields.preservation: binding to actual passed preservation result
config_fields.tested_inputs: binding to complete original 6444-file checkpoint; never thin it
config_fields.page_qa: binding to actual page QA receipt
config_fields.visual_observation: binding to real static image observation
config_fields.root_assessment: binding to explicit acceptance document specified below
config_fields.display_approval: required exact tuple-array binding when old node display cells differ
config_fields.display_assessment: required source-backed assessment binding for that nonempty delta
config_fields.additional_artifacts: optional array: name, original binding, mode exact/lossless_utf8/credential_header_projection; projection also requires explicit projection_description and hash-bound full_original

root_assessment_fields.status: accepted only after real receipt review
root_assessment_fields.bindings: exact config binding objects for gates, preservation, tested_inputs, page_qa, visual_observation and any display approvals
root_assessment_fields.gate_summary: actual completed gate/test summary including skips/warnings and scope; no forecast
root_assessment_fields.visual_summary: actual static image observation with density and scope limits
root_assessment_fields.limitations: nonempty list of actual limitations; include later Git/PR lifecycle

projection_policy: JSON wrappers are lossless original bytes, not truncated logs. Credential-header projections are explicitly scoped and retain full original external hash binding; do not label them lossless originals.
final_seal_dependencies: exact archive plans and added-file hashes
all old 227 records/pages and 101 review bundles preserved
exact final inventory and bounded post-finalization preservation

v2_assembly_fields.scope: full original tested set plus exact rubric/current graph/page and gate archive inputs; no saved output existence required before save

v2_dependency_checks: exact commands, ROOT cwd, pinned Python/env, zero exit, ordered aware timestamps and two exact bound streams
native save/history/check stdout agrees with the bound actual saved outputs
full assembly/config/archive and current target/source lineage at every completion consumer
all_current_files exact ROOT/path binding, unique full inventory and no symlink escape
archive plan exact config mapping, duplicate and file/ancestor conflicts rejected before writes
post-save archive complete sealed package plus actual assembly/native trees, exact original and lossless wrapper bytes
